hooks.command: python3 -c 'from openhands.sdk import LLM; from openhands.sdk.llm.llm_profile_store import LLMProfileStore; from pydantic import SecretStr; s=LLMProfileStore(); names=[n.removesuffix(".json") for n in s.list()]; None if "spark2.5-4b" in names else s.save("spark2.5-4b", LLM(model="openai/spark2.5-4b", base_url="http://host.docker.internal:30000/v1", api_key=SecretStr("local"), usage_id="spark2.5-4b"), include_secrets=True)'

python3 -c 'import json; print(json.dumps({"additionalContext":"BIBLIOTECARIO WORKFLOW IS ATTACHED. For software-engineering work, the parent is an orchestrator only. Use planner-qwen -> executor-spark -> reviewer-qwen through the task tool. Never implement, test, inspect, or review directly in the parent. Fail closed if a required phase cannot start."}))'
python3 -c 'import json; print(json.dumps({"decision":"deny","reason":"Bibliotecario parent is orchestration-only; repository tools belong to delegated phase agents"}))'

python3 -c 'import json,sys,os; from openhands.sdk.llm.llm_profile_store import LLMProfileStore; e=json.load(sys.stdin); i=e.get("tool_input") or {}; a=i.get("subagent_type"); allowed={"planner-qwen","executor-spark","reviewer-qwen"}; ok=a in allowed; reason="Only Bibliotecario phase agents may be delegated"; p=os.path.join(e.get("working_dir") or os.getcwd(),"PLAN.md"); exists=os.path.isfile(p); profiles=[n.removesuffix(".json") for n in LLMProfileStore().list()]; ok=ok and (a!="executor-spark" or (exists and "spark2.5-4b" in profiles)); reason=reason if a not in allowed else ("executor-spark requires PLAN.md and runtime profile spark2.5-4b" if a=="executor-spark" and not (exists and "spark2.5-4b" in profiles) else "Bibliotecario delegation allowed"); print(json.dumps({"decision":"allow" if ok else "deny","reason":reason}))' || exit 2
